claims.text: Used for severe, and sometimes moderate, envenomation; many experts consult a toxicologist first
claims.quote: Many experts recommend consultation with a toxicologist before giving antivenom. Although death from widow spider bites is rare, symptoms may persist for weeks or months, so antivenom is used if envenomation is severe or sometimes moderate.

claims.text: Most effective early, but can work up to 36 hours after the bite; response is usually dramatic
claims.quote: Antivenom is most effective when used early, but can be effective up to 36 hours after the bite. Clinical response is usually dramatic.

claims.text: The manufacturer recommends skin testing first, though testing doesn't always predict reactions such as anaphylaxis
claims.quote: The manufacturer recommends skin testing before administering the antivenom, although testing does not always predict adverse reactions such as anaphylaxis.
